visual_language.direction: technical blueprint schematic, thin cyan line-work on deep navy, faint blueprint frame and grid, nodes and connectors, boxed-node architecture diagrams with arrows, engineering drawing precision, calm title zone, no text

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以深蓝底青色制图线稿、节点连线管线图与唯一珊瑚强调表达工程 / 学术蓝图的示意精确性
legacy_payload.visual_direction: technical blueprint schematic, thin cyan line-work on deep navy, faint blueprint frame and grid, nodes and connectors, boxed-node architecture diagrams with arrows, engineering drawing precision, calm title zone, no text

canvas.background: deep navy blueprint ground #0A1B38 with faint frame / grid
canvas.composition: cyan schematic line-work panels, boxed nodes + connector arrows, mono eyebrow chrome

color_palette.primary: deep navy ground #0A1B38, blueprint white #EAF2FF line ink
color_palette.secondary: schematic cyan #46B4E8 for line-work, rules and nodes
color_palette.accent: the ONE warm coral #F1764E, reserved for the focal path / result
color_palette.neutral: steel muted #8FA6C4 for captions and chrome
color_palette.rule: ONE coral accent only; line-work stays thin — no filled multi-colour nodes

typography.title: engineering sans (Arial / 思源黑体), calm and structural
typography.body: clean sans (Arial / 思源黑体) on dark panels
typography.labels: mono eyebrow / figure chrome (Consolas / 等宽), tracked caps
typography.text_quality: drafting-table precision, high contrast on navy

layout_patterns: blueprint panel: dark navy panel with faint frame/grid and mono eyebrow
boxed-node diagram: architecture / pipeline built from boxed nodes + arrows in thin cyan
focal path highlight: the single coral accent marks the result or critical path
cover = navy ground + faint blueprint frame + cyan schematic motif + calm title zone
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Build diagrams from boxed nodes and thin cyan connectors; the coral accent marks exactly one focal element per slide.
negative_prompt: no thick heavy outlines or filled solid blocks
no second warm accent competing with the coral
no light/white slide ground — the deep navy IS the register
no curved connector lines, hand-drawn organic shapes, or photographic elements

visual_elements.allowed: thin cyan line-work, boxed nodes, connector arrows, faint grids, mono chrome, native tables and typeset equations
visual_elements.avoid: filled colorful nodes, gradients, glass panels, rounded soft cards

rendering_constraints: Thin cyan line-work on deep navy, engineering drawing feel.
Diagrams as boxed nodes + arrows, never loose sketches.
Connector lines use straight lines or 90-degree angles only.
Cross-section diagrams and isometric/orthographic projections for component views.

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案
